Troy Franklin added a deep touchdown of his own, flashing the vertical juice that made him a draft steal. And Pat Bryant kept moving the chains with physical routes and reliable hands. But the ground game… JK Dobbins and the RB group were largely shut down. Was it poor execution — or did the defense finally clamp down and control the trenches. Late in practice, the defense surged: tighter coverage, better fits, more disruption. Cecil breaks down whether that late push means the defense actually dominated the day… or if the offense still won the majority of reps. 🔥 In this episode: An update on Nik Bonitto's injury Did the defense truly dominate Day 4 — or just finish strong Waddle vs. Surtain: the heavyweight matchup delivers again Mims and Franklin stack long touchdowns in team drills Pat Bryant continues his rise as a chain‑mover Why the run game stalled — and how much credit the defense deserves If you’re riding with us through camp, hit LIKE, SUBSCRIBE, and drop your Day 4 take — did the defense really dominate.
